description: Trader Joe's latte pretzels — wrinkled bag, sideways, nested brackets; milk/wheat/soy allergens
notes: Cross-check 2026-08-12 added 'Cocoa Powder Processed With Alkali', which the label lists as a distinct ingredient immediately after plain 'Cocoa Powder' and the seed transcription had collapsed into it. Label declares CONTAINS MILK, SOY, WHEAT. 'MAY CONTAIN EGG, PEANUT, ALMOND, CASHEW, COCONUT, PECAN' is a may-contain line — none of those six may appear in detected allergens. Malted Barley Flour makes this gluten-containing beyond wheat, but barley is not a US major allergen and is correctly absent from majorAllergens.
